name: Simulated student models for fractions (Princeton)
summary: A planned pipeline and neural simulated student models for fraction arithmetic, trained on rule-based students' synthetic reasoning together with real students' reasoning.

license.note: Stated intent for the codebase; no license is named for the model weights or data.

cite: Princeton University. Pipeline for Training Simulated Student Models with Reduced Human Data. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project, https://k12-ai-infrastructure.org/princeton-university/
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.

fits.how: Could play a learner who holds known fraction errors in agent tests.
